# Certified CPU controller, version 3

Extend the supplied FENIX CPU controller. Its model evaluators classify nine-packet length/IPD windows, its control-plane compiler builds a sampled probability table, and its reporting code aggregates window predictions into flows. Implement joint certified export planning between these stages. The fixed model assets are part of the contract, not a training task. Reserved service opportunities abstract the inference/link pipeline; this is an offline controller extension and makes no hardware-timing or learned-accuracy reproduction claim.

## Input

The entry is `python3 -B /workspace/submission/main.py`, cwd /workspace. Read exactly one UTF-8 JSON object to EOF. Keys must be unique at every depth. Reject invalid UTF-8, trailing JSON, nonfinite numbers, booleans/decimal/exponent values in integer fields, unknown/missing keys, depth over64 containers, and every schema violation below. Input is at most16MiB. Invalid input returns exactly `{"error":"invalid"}` and exits0, with no partial results. Valid input returns `{"version":3,"results":[RESULT,...]}` in case order. Object order/whitespace are irrelevant; arrays have the specified order and JSON types are exact except for the report scalar number equivalence stated below.

Top-level keys: exactly `version,cases`. Version is integer3. cases has0–8 epochs; at most1024 total windows across the batch. Each epoch has exactly `model,class_values,stats,bucket,slots,flows,groups,windows`:

| Field | Meaning and bounds |
|---|---|
| model | exactly the string `cnn` or `rnn`, selecting the corresponding bundled seven-class model |
| class_values | seven integer utilities1–1000, indexed by predicted class |
| stats | `[N,Q,V]`, positive integers ≤10^9: global observations supplied to `probability.calculate_probability_model(Q,N,V)`; the table compiler converts its elapsed-time samples by dividing by1000 |
| bucket | `[B,I]`: capacity1–512 tokens, initial0–B |
| slots |1–256 rows `[time,capacity,refill]`: strictly increasing integer times0–10^12; service capacity0–512; refill0–512; first refill must be0 |
| flows |1–32 rows `[target,ceiling,group,label]`: target1–64, ceiling target–512; group=-1 or a group index; fixed true class label0–6 |
| groups |0–32 rows `[parent,ceiling]`: parent=-1 or a group index; parent links must be acyclic, in any input order; ceiling0–512 |
| windows |0–512 rows `[flow,ready,expires,T,C,draw,priority,features]`: flow is a zero-based flow index; ready0–10^12, expires ready–10^12; T1–65535, C1–320; draw0–65535; priority1–1000; features exactly nine `[length,IPD]` integer rows, length0–1500 and IPD0–2560, oldest first |

Each window row is a distinct indivisible candidate, identified by its input index. `ready` includes feature formation and fixed transfer lead time; `expires` is its last permitted export opportunity after accounting for the reserved inference pipeline. T and C are measured age and packet backlog from a preceding frozen observation period; choosing a window does not change another window's T,C. Any window may be assigned at most once, to a slot with ready≤time≤expires, and only if it passes its gate. Each flow receives at most its ceiling. A group limits the total selected windows of every flow attached to it or any descendant; all ancestor ceilings apply simultaneously. Group=-1 means no group; parent=-1 means a root. Groups may have no attached flows. These are explicit control-epoch resource policies; they are not classification labels. There is no required order among windows of the same flow and no extra FIFO constraint: slots are reserved service opportunities, not a simulation queue.

## Model predictions, compiled gates and finite tokens

For every window, including ones later rejected, run the selected evaluator's `evaluate_model_single_pass` on its features. The bundled `testcnnonnx.py`, `testrnnonnx.py`, `data_loader_npy.py`, assets and NumPy1.26.4/ONNX Runtime1.16.3 CPU path define the prediction primitive. Use one-window inference and the supplied one-thread sequential session settings. Its integer output is the lowest class index attaining the maximum first model output. CNN output is shape(1,7); RNN's shape(7) is intentional. No other model, training, randomized approximation or accelerator is needed. Window j has exact integer value priority_j*class_values[prediction_j]. These values affect planning; true labels affect only reports.

Compile the table once per epoch with the supplied `probability.calculate_probability_model(Q,N,V)`. Its published code, including the20x20 binary64 sampled grid, elapsed-time /1000 conversion, clipping, equality tolerance and floor-to65535 conversion, is the normative primitive. Look up the unique row whose inclusive elapsed and count ranges contain T,C; its last integer is the window threshold (default0 if no row). `window_thresholds` implements this lookup. A window passes exactly when draw<threshold. A threshold65535 rejects draw65535. Do not substitute an unsampled continuous formula or a different rounding rule. The public compiler is supplied and need not be reimplemented. Selected windows each consume one token and one service unit.

Initially I tokens are available at the first slot. At every later slot, add that slot's refill and discard tokens above B before allocating exports. Exports at a slot cannot exceed its service capacity or available tokens; unspent tokens carry to the next slot. No refill occurs between slots. Token sources may be unused: using an earlier available token instead of a later one has no objective advantage. Saturation can make a total-epoch token budget insufficient as a feasibility test.

## Objective and output

Let n_f be the number of chosen windows of flow f, and t_f its target. Coverage is r=min(1,min_f(n_f/t_f)). First maximize r. Among those allocations maximize U, the sum of chosen values. Among those minimize A, the sum of (assigned slot time-ready) for chosen windows. All ties are allowed; do not invent a tie-break. Even when r=0, the later objectives apply. An empty selection is always feasible, so every valid epoch has a solution.

A RESULT has exactly `predictions,reports,ratio,thresholds,assignment,utility,age,flow,potential,cut`:

- predictions contains one class0–6 per input window in input order.
- reports is `metrics.selected_report(flows,windows,predictions,assignment)` as specified below.
- ratio is `[p,q]` in lowest terms, 0≤p≤q≤64, q≥1, expressing optimal r.
- thresholds contains one exact threshold per input window.
- assignment contains one slot index or -1 per input window.
- utility and age are exact U,A.
- flow, potential, cut are the certificates defined next. They are required, not optional claims by the program.

## Selected-window reports

Report exactly `{"packet":METRICS,"stream":METRICS}`. Packet labels are the true flow label and predicted class of each selected window. A stream is a flow with at least one selected window; its predicted label is the most frequent selected-window class, breaking count ties by the earliest selected window in **input order**, independent of service order. Its true label is that flow's fixed label. No unselected window or unrepresented flow contributes to either report.

METRICS has exactly `confusion,accuracy,macro_precision,macro_recall,macro_f1`. Confusion is a7x7 integer matrix with true labels as rows and predicted labels as columns. For each class, precision=TP/(TP+FP), recall=TP/(TP+FN), F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN), with zero for a zero denominator. Macro metrics average **all seven** classes, including absent classes. Accuracy is correct/total, or0 for an empty sample. Empty reports contain an all-zero confusion matrix and four zeros. The supplied metric routines implement these semantics and include empty-set handling. The four scalar metrics may use integer, decimal or exponent JSON number notation (for example1,1.0,1e0 are equivalent); booleans are not numbers. After standard Python JSON decoding, their values must be finite and within absolute1e-9 of the mathematical values, with no relative tolerance. Confusion and every other integer field remain exact JSON integers; decimal/exponent notation is not valid there. These reports describe selected classifications, not the optimization objective.

## Certificate coordinate system

This defines a constraint network solely to make certificates machine-checkable; no solver, graph constructor or optimizer is supplied. Let S,J,F,G be slot, window, flow and group counts. Node0 is a token source R; node1 a completion sink Z. For each slot s, nodes a_s=2+3s, b_s=3+3s, e_s=4+3s represent token intake, capped inventory and reserved service. Window j has node w_j=2+3S+j. Flow f has node z_f=2+3S+J+f. Group g has node h_g=2+3S+J+F+g. There are K=2+3S+J+F+G nodes. Let W=1+J*(last slot time). Every arc has lower0/cost0 unless specified. Construct the following ordered arc list; omit no zero-capacity arc:

1. For each slot s in order: R→a_s has capacity I for s=0, otherwise refill_s; a_s→b_s capacity B; if s+1<S, b_s→a_(s+1) capacity B; b_s→e_s capacity capacity_s. Within a slot use this stated order.
2. For every eligible (slot s,window j), in slot-major then window-index order, e_s→w_j has capacity1 and cost `(time_s-ready_j)-value_j*W`. Eligible means the window passes and ready_j≤time_s≤expires_j.
3. For each window j in order: w_j→z_(flow_j), capacity1.
4. For each flow f in order: z_f→h_(group_f), or z_f→Z if group=-1, lower ceil(r*target_f), capacity ceiling_f.
5. For each group g in order: h_g→h_(parent_g), or h_g→Z if parent=-1, capacity ceiling_g.
6. Z→R, capacity J.

A `flow` is an integer for every arc in this order, within its lower/capacity bounds, conserving flow at every node. An eligible-pair arc has flow1 exactly when assignment[j]=s; an unassigned window has none. Utility/age and r must agree with the assignment and objective. Any valid token provenance may be used; no particular carry/refill decomposition is required.

`potential` has one mathematical integer per node, each with absolute value ≤10^60. For every arc (u,v,l,h,c) with reported amount x, require c+potential[u]-potential[v]≥0 if x<h, and -c+potential[v]-potential[u]≥0 if x>l. No condition is imposed in a direction with no residual capacity. These inequalities certify the optimum of the final two objectives at the reported coverage. W makes one utility unit dominate the entire possible waiting-age range; it is a certificate cost convention, not a runtime or scoring threshold. Potentials need not be unique or normalized.

For maximal coverage, define the finite public set Rset={k/target_f: f ranges over flows, k=0..target_f}. The reported r must belong to this set. If r=1, cut must be null. Otherwise let r+ be the smallest Rset member strictly larger than r. Use the same arc list but replace each flow lower bound by ceil(r+*target_f). `cut` is a list of distinct node IDs describing a subset X for which **sum of lower bounds on arcs entering X exceeds sum of capacities on arcs leaving X**. Arcs wholly inside/outside do not contribute. This is an infeasibility obstruction for the next larger coverage; any such set, in any order, is accepted. A result must satisfy both the allocation and its certificates; a locally plausible allocation or an unproved objective is insufficient.

The public check supplies no allocation optimizer, objective evaluator or graph/certificate evaluator. It checks a tiny static result and JSON/CLI behavior. All constraints and the full domain above are normative.

Only frozen submission bytes are executed; editing public runner/checker/protocol files does not affect verification. The task provides CPython 3.11.14 on Linux x86-64, CPU only.

Each invocation handles the **whole** batch within 150 seconds wall time. Local worker limits are 180 CPU seconds soft /181 hard per process, 2 GiB address space per process, 64 processes/threads per reserved UID for the outer generic worker; the candidate child itself is restricted to one process/one thread by the public runner, 256 open descriptors per process, 64 MiB per regular file, zero core dumps. This local profile has no hard aggregate cgroup CPU/memory/storage guarantee and shares the host kernel. It is a local development/trial profile, not proof of hostile-kernel isolation. === data_loader_npy.py ===
"""Traffic sequence storage, validation and CPU batch collation."""
import os
import numpy as np

class TrafficSequenceDatasetFromNPY:
    def __init__(self, data_file, labels_file, sequence_length=9):
        if not os.path.isfile(data_file):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Data file not found: {data_file}")
        if not os.path.isfile(labels_file):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Labels file not found: {labels_file}")
        self.sequences = np.load(data_file, allow_pickle=False)
        self.labels = np.load(labels_file, allow_pickle=False)
        self._validate(sequence_length)

    @classmethod
    def from_arrays(cls, sequences, labels, sequence_length=9):
        result = cls.__new__(cls)
        result.sequences = np.asarray(sequences, dtype=np.int64).reshape((-1,sequence_length,2))
        result.labels = np.asarray(labels, dtype=np.int64)
        result._validate(sequence_length)
        return result

    def _validate(self, sequence_length):
        if len(self.sequences) != len(self.labels):
            raise ValueError(f"Data length mismatch: {len(self.sequences)} vs {len(self.labels)}")
        self.sequences = self.sequences.astype(np.int64, copy=False)
        self.labels = self.labels.astype(np.int64, copy=False)
        if self.sequences.ndim != 3 or self.sequences.shape[1] != sequence_length:
            raise ValueError("Sequence length mismatch")
        if self.sequences.shape[2] != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"Feature dimension error: expected 2, got {self.sequences.shape[2]}")

    def __len__(self):
        return self.sequences.shape[0]

    def __getitem__(self, index):
        return self.sequences[index], self.labels[index]

def traffic_collate_fn_npy(batch):
    sequences, labels = zip(*batch)
    return np.stack(sequences, axis=0), np.asarray(labels,dtype=np.int64)

=== metrics.py ===
"""Packet and flow classification reports, including empty selected sets."""
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import numpy as np

def compute_and_log_metrics(true_labels, pred_labels, num_classes=7):
    true_labels = np.array(true_labels, dtype=np.int64)
    pred_labels = np.array(pred_labels, dtype=np.int64)
    confusion_matrix_flat = np.bincount(
        np.ravel_multi_index((true_labels, pred_labels), (num_classes, num_classes)),
        minlength=num_classes*num_classes
    )
    confusion_matrix = confusion_matrix_flat.reshape(num_classes, num_classes)
    tp_per_class = np.diag(confusion_matrix)
    fp_per_class = np.sum(confusion_matrix, axis=0) - tp_per_class
    fn_per_class = np.sum(confusion_matrix, axis=1) - tp_per_class
    tn_per_class = np.sum(confusion_matrix) - (fp_per_class + fn_per_class + tp_per_class)
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
        precision_per_class = tp_per_class / (tp_per_class + fp_per_class)
        recall_per_class = tp_per_class / (tp_per_class + fn_per_class)
        per_class_accuracy = (tp_per_class + tn_per_class) / len(true_labels) if len(true_labels) > 0 else np.zeros(num_classes)
        precision_per_class = np.nan_to_num(precision_per_class, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
        recall_per_class = np.nan_to_num(recall_per_class, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
        per_class_accuracy = np.nan_to_num(per_class_accuracy, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
        f1_per_class = 2 * (precision_per_class * recall_per_class) / (precision_per_class + recall_per_class)
        f1_per_class = np.nan_to_num(f1_per_class, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    macro_precision = np.mean(precision_per_class)
    macro_recall = np.mean(recall_per_class)
    macro_f1 = np.mean(f1_per_class)
    correct_predictions = np.sum(tp_per_class)
    total_samples = len(true_labels)
    accuracy = correct_predictions / total_samples if total_samples > 0 else 0.0
    return {'confusion':confusion_matrix.tolist(), 'accuracy':float(accuracy),
        'macro_precision':float(macro_precision), 'macro_recall':float(macro_recall),
        'macro_f1':float(macro_f1)}

def selected_report(flows, windows, predictions, assignment):
    stream_data_dict = defaultdict(list)
    true_packet_labels = []
    predicted_packet_labels = []
    for i in range(len(windows)):
        if assignment[i] < 0:
            continue
        flow = windows[i][0]
        stream_data_dict[flow].append(i)
        true_packet_labels.append(flows[flow][3])
        predicted_packet_labels.append(predictions[i])
    true_stream_labels = []
    predicted_stream_labels = []
    for flow, indices in stream_data_dict.items():
        window_predictions = [predictions[i] for i in indices]
        vote_counts = Counter(window_predictions)
        stream_prediction = vote_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
        true_stream_labels.append(flows[flow][3])
        predicted_stream_labels.append(stream_prediction)
    return {'packet':compute_and_log_metrics(true_packet_labels,predicted_packet_labels),
        'stream':compute_and_log_metrics(true_stream_labels,predicted_stream_labels)}
=== probability.py ===
"""CPU probability-table compiler and range lookup."""
import numpy as np

def calculate_probability_model(pkt_count, flow_count, feature_rate=75):
    
    N = flow_count if flow_count > 0 else 1
    V = feature_rate
    Q = pkt_count if pkt_count > 0 else 1
    
    threshold_NV = N / V
    threshold_QN = Q / N
    
    T_min, T_max = 1, 65535
    C_min, C_max = 1, 320
    num_samples_per_axis = 20 
    sample_T = np.linspace(T_min, T_max, num_samples_per_axis)
    sample_C = np.linspace(C_min, C_max, num_samples_per_axis)
    probability_table_data = []
    T_step = (T_max - T_min) // num_samples_per_axis
    C_step = (C_max - C_min) // num_samples_per_axis
    
    for i, T_i in enumerate(sample_T):
        for j, C_i in enumerate(sample_C):

"""Fixed-model single-pass CPU inference."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import onnxruntime as ort
from data_loader_npy import TrafficSequenceDatasetFromNPY, traffic_collate_fn_npy

_SESSION = None

def evaluate_model_single_pass(sequences, labels):
    global _SESSION
    dataset = TrafficSequenceDatasetFromNPY.from_arrays(sequences, labels)
    if _SESSION is None:
        options = ort.SessionOptions()
        options.intra_op_num_threads = 1
        options.inter_op_num_threads = 1
        options.execution_mode = ort.ExecutionMode.ORT_SEQUENTIAL
        _SESSION = ort.InferenceSession(str(Path('/workspace/assets/rnn.onnx')),
            sess_options=options,providers=['CPUExecutionProvider'])
    session = _SESSION
    input_name = session.get_inputs()[0].name
    all_window_predictions = []
    batch_size = 1
    num_windows = len(dataset)
    num_batches = (num_windows + batch_size - 1) // batch_size
    for i in range(num_batches):
        start_idx = i * batch_size
        end_idx = min((i + 1) * batch_size, num_windows)
        batch_tensor_np, _ = traffic_collate_fn_npy([dataset[j] for j in range(start_idx,end_idx)])
        try:
            ort_inputs = {input_name: batch_tensor_np}
            outputs = session.run(None, ort_inputs)
            log_probs_output = outputs[0]
            if log_probs_output.ndim == 1:
                predicted_batch = np.array([np.argmax(log_probs_output)])
            elif log_probs_output.ndim == 2:
                predicted_batch = np.argmax(log_probs_output, axis=1)
            else:
                raise ValueError(f"Unexpected output dimensions: {log_probs_output.ndim}, shape: {log_probs_output.shape}")
            all_window_predictions.extend(predicted_batch.tolist())
        except Exception as e:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Model inference failed for batch {i}") from e
    return all_window_predictions

"""Certified epoch planning.

Builds the constraint network of PROTOCOL.md, maximises the minimum normalised
flow coverage, then the predicted-class utility, then minimises the waiting
age, and returns the schedule together with a feasible circulation, residual
potentials and (when coverage is below one) a next-ratio infeasibility cut.

Internally the planner solves a min-cost circulation with lower bounds by
transforming it into a min-cost flow with only nonnegative arc costs: every
window arc is pre-saturated (each window is either exported at some slot or
explicitly dropped) and the negative reward of an export is carried by the
reverse arc.  Node potentials of that network are mapped back onto the
published cost convention at the end.
"""

from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right
from heapq import heappush, heappop
from fractions import Fraction

BIG = 1 << 110
MAX_BLOCK_ITER = 4000


class Graph:
    """Residual arc list; window nodes keep a compact dynamic adjacency."""

    __slots__ = ('n', 'to', 'cap', 'cost', 'adj')

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.to = []
        self.cap = []
        self.cost = []
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def add(self, u, v, c, cost=0, head_adj=True):
        i = len(self.to)
        self.to.append(v)
        self.cap.append(c)
        self.cost.append(cost)
        self.to.append(u)
        self.cap.append(0)
        self.cost.append(-cost)
        self.adj[u].append(i)
        if head_adj:
            self.adj[v].append(i + 1)
        return i


def _log_table(limit):
    log = [0] * (limit + 1)
    for i in range(2, limit + 1):
        log[i] = log[i >> 1] + 1
    return log


def _build_rmq(vals, size):
    """Sparse table of the two smallest (value, index) pairs of every range."""
    levels = []
    m1 = list(vals)
    i1 = list(range(size))
    m2 = [BIG] * size
    i2 = [-1] * size
    levels.append((m1, i1, m2, i2))
    j = 1
    while (1 << j) <= size:
        half = 1 << (j - 1)
        pm1, pi1, pm2, pi2 = levels[j - 1]
        nsize = size - (1 << j) + 1
        nm1 = [0] * nsize
        ni1 = [0] * nsize
        nm2 = [0] * nsize
        ni2 = [0] * nsize
        for i in range(nsize):
            k = i + half
            a1 = pm1[i]
            a2 = pm2[i]
            b1 = pm1[k]
            b2 = pm2[k]
            if a1 <= b1:
                nm1[i] = a1
                ni1[i] = pi1[i]
                if a2 <= b1:
                    nm2[i] = a2
                    ni2[i] = pi2[i]
                else:
                    nm2[i] = b1
                    ni2[i] = pi1[k]
            else:
                nm1[i] = b1
                ni1[i] = pi1[k]
                if b2 <= a1:
                    nm2[i] = b2
                    ni2[i] = pi2[k]
                else:
                    nm2[i] = a1
                    ni2[i] = pi1[i]
        levels.append((nm1, ni1, nm2, ni2))
        j += 1
    return levels


def _rmq_query(levels, log, l, r):
    k = log[r - l + 1]
    m1a, i1a, m2a, i2a = levels[k]
    x = l
    y = r - (1 << k) + 1
    a1 = m1a[x]
    a2 = m2a[x]
    b1 = m1a[y]
    b2 = m2a[y]
    if a1 <= b1:
        if a2 <= b1:
            return a1, i1a[x], a2, i2a[x]
        return a1, i1a[x], b1, i1a[y]
    if b2 <= a1:
        return b1, i1a[y], b2, i2a[y]
    return b1, i1a[y], a1, i1a[x]


def _dinic_path(g, cap, level, it, s, t, wlo, whi, wadj):
    to = g.to
    adj = g.adj
    path = []
    u = s
    while True:
        if u == t:
            f = min(cap[i] for i in path)
            for i in path:
                cap[i] -= f
                cap[i ^ 1] += f
            return f
        arcs = wadj[u - wlo] if wlo <= u < whi else adj[u]
        target = level[u] + 1
        idx = it[u]
        na = len(arcs)
        found = -1
        while idx < na:
            i = arcs[idx]
            if cap[i] > 0 and level[to[i]] == target:
                found = i
                break
            idx += 1
        it[u] = idx
        if found >= 0:
            path.append(found)
            u = to[found]
        else:
            if not path:
                return 0
            it[u] = na
            i = path.pop()
            u = to[i ^ 1]
            it[u] += 1


def dinic(g, cap, s, t, wlo, whi, wadj):
    to = g.to
    adj = g.adj
    n = g.n
    total = 0
    while True:
        level = [-1] * n
        level[s] = 0
        q = [s]
        qs = 0
        lt = -1
        while qs < len(q):
            u = q[qs]
            qs += 1
            lu = level[u] + 1
            if lt >= 0 and lu > lt:
                continue
            arcs = wadj[u - wlo] if wlo <= u < whi else adj[u]
            for i in arcs:
                if cap[i] > 0:
                    v = to[i]
                    if level[v] < 0:
                        level[v] = lu
                        if v == t:
                            lt = lu
                        q.append(v)
        if lt < 0:
            break
        it = [0] * n
        nwin = whi - wlo
        while True:
            f = _dinic_path(g, cap, level, it, s, t, wlo, whi, wadj)
            if f == 0:
                break
            total += f
            for j in range(nwin):
                it[wlo + j] = 0
    return total


class Net:
    """The transformed planning network of one epoch."""

    __slots__ = ('g', 'n', 'base_cap', 'S', 'F', 'G', 'J', 'W0', 'Z0', 'H0',
                 'K', 'SS', 'TT', 'wadj', 'assigned', 'wdist', 'earc',
                 'arc_zw', 'wflow', 'lo', 'hi', 'log', 'slot_windows',
                 'arc_zhead', 'arc_Sh', 'arc_SZ', 'arc_Sz', 'arc_zT',
                 'wready', 'wvalue', 'times', 'dist', 'parent', 'pi')

    def __init__(self):
        self.pi = None


def build_net(times, caps, refills, B, I, F, fceil, fgroup, G, gparent, gceil,
              J, wflow, wready, slot_windows, value, W):
    S = len(times)
    W0 = 2 + 3 * S
    Z0 = W0 + J
    H0 = Z0 + F
    K = H0 + G
    SS = K
    TT = K + 1
    n = K + 2
    g = Graph(n)
    net = Net()
    net.g = g
    net.n = n
    net.S = S
    net.F = F
    net.G = G
    net.J = J
    net.W0 = W0
    net.Z0 = Z0
    net.H0 = H0
    net.K = K
    net.SS = SS
    net.TT = TT
    net.times = times
    net.wready = wready
    net.wvalue = value
    net.wflow = wflow
    net.slot_windows = slot_windows

    ymap = []
    add = g.add
    earc = [-1] * (S * J) if J else []

    # 1. slot arcs
    for s in range(S):
        a = 2 + 3 * s
        b = 3 + 3 * s
        e = 4 + 3 * s
        intake = I if s == 0 else refills[s]
        add(0, a, intake, 0)
        ymap.append(None)
        add(a, b, B, 0)
        ymap.append(None)
        if s + 1 < S:
            add(b, 2 + 3 * (s + 1), B, 0)
            ymap.append(None)
        add(b, e, caps[s], times[s])
        ymap.append(None)

    # 2. eligible pair arcs (slot major, then window index); heads are window
    #    nodes so their reverse arcs are tracked through the compact adjacency.
    for s in range(S):
        e = 4 + 3 * s
        base = s * J
        for j in slot_windows[s]:
            ai = add(e, W0 + j, 1, 0, head_adj=False)
            ymap.append(('E', s, j))
            earc[base + j] = ai
    net.earc = earc

    # 3. window arcs, pre-saturated and therefore reversed
    arc_zw = [0] * J
    arc_wz = [0] * J
    wadj = [None] * J
    for j in range(J):
        f = wflow[j]
        cost = wready[j] + value[j] * W
        ai = add(Z0 + f, W0 + j, 1, cost, head_adj=False)
        ymap.append(('W', j))
        arc_zw[j] = ai
        arc_wz[j] = ai + 1
    net.arc_zw = arc_zw
    net.arc_wz = arc_wz

    # 4. flow arcs (lower bound removed, shifted into the node imbalance)
    arc_zhead = [0] * F
    for f in range(F):
        gp = fgroup[f]
        head = H0 + gp if gp >= 0 else 1
        ai = add(Z0 + f, head, fceil[f], 0)
        ymap.append(('Z', f))
        arc_zhead[f] = ai
    net.arc_zhead = arc_zhead

    # 5. group arcs
    for gi in range(G):
        p = gparent[gi]
        head = H0 + p if p >= 0 else 1
        add(H0 + gi, head, gceil[gi], 0)
        ymap.append(('H', gi))

    # 6. completion sink back to the token source
    add(1, 0, J, 0)
    ymap.append(('ZR',))

    # imbalance arcs
    arc_Sh = [0] * G
    for gi in range(G):
        arc_Sh[gi] = add(SS, H0 + gi, 0, 0)
    arc_SZ = add(SS, 1, 0, 0)
    arc_Sz = [0] * F
    for f in range(F):
        arc_Sz[f] = add(SS, Z0 + f, 0, 0)
    arc_zT = [0] * F
    for f in range(F):
        arc_zT[f] = add(Z0 + f, TT, 0, 0)
    arc_wT = [0] * J
    for j in range(J):
        arc_wT[j] = add(W0 + j, TT, 1, 0, head_adj=False)
        wadj[j] = [arc_wT[j], arc_wz[j]]
    net.arc_Sh = arc_Sh
    net.arc_SZ = arc_SZ
    net.arc_Sz = arc_Sz
    net.arc_zT = arc_zT
    net.wadj = wadj
    net.assigned = [-1] * J
    net.wdist = [BIG] * J
    net.base_cap = list(g.cap)

    # block Dijkstra adjacency: arcs entering a window node are handled by the
    # window recomputation step instead.
    WJ0 = W0
    WJ1 = W0 + J
    to = g.to
    adjA = []
    for u in range(n):
        lst = [i for i in g.adj[u] if not (WJ0 <= to[i] < WJ1)]
        adjA.append(lst)
    net.adjA = adjA
    net.log = _log_table(S) if S else [0]
    net.ymap = ymap
    net.pi = [0] * n
    net.dist = [BIG] * n
    net.parent = [-1] * n
    net.kbuf = [BIG] * S if S else []
    return net


def set_coverage(net, lowers, Jf):
    """Install the flow lower bounds ceil(r*target_f) and the imbalance caps."""
    cap = net.g.cap
    F = net.F
    G = net.G
    J = net.J
    sum_group = [0] * G
    sum_root = 0
    for f in range(F):
        sum_group[f] = 0
    for f in range(F):
        gp = net.fgroup[f]
        lf = lowers[f]
        if gp >= 0:
            sum_group[gp] += lf
        else:
            sum_root += lf
    for f in range(F):
        i = net.arc_zhead[f]
        cap[i] = net.fceil[f] - lowers[f]
        cap[i + 1] = lowers[f]
        i = net.arc_Sz[f]
        extra = Jf[f] - lowers[f]
        cap[i] = extra if extra > 0 else 0
        i = net.arc_zT[f]
        deficit = lowers[f] - Jf[f]
        cap[i] = deficit if deficit > 0 else 0
    for gi in range(G):
        i = net.arc_Sh[gi]
        cap[i] = sum_group[gi]
    i = net.arc_SZ
    cap[i] = sum_root
    need = 0
    for f in range(F):
        d = Jf[f] if Jf[f] > lowers[f] else lowers[f]
        need += d
    return need


def _block_a(net, cap):
    """Dijkstra over the non-window subgraph; window labels are sources."""
    g = net.g
    to = g.to
    cost = g.cost
    adjA = net.adjA
    n = net.n
    pi = net.pi
    dist = [BIG] * n
    parent = [-1] * n
    heap = []
    ss = net.SS
    dist[ss] = 0
    heappush(heap, (0, ss))
    changed = False
    W0 = net.W0
    J = net.J
    wdist = net.wdist
    wadj = net.wadj
    for j in range(J):
        d = wdist[j]
        if d >= BIG:
            continue
        u = W0 + j
        pu = pi[u]
        for i in wadj[j]:
            if cap[i] > 0:
                v = to[i]
                nd = d + cost[i] + pu - pi[v]
                if nd < dist[v]:
                    dist[v] = nd
                    parent[v] = i
                    changed = True
                    heappush(heap, (nd, v))
    pop = heappop
    push = heappush
    while heap:
        d, u = pop(heap)
        if d > dist[u]:
            continue
        pu = pi[u]
        for i in adjA[u]:
            if cap[i] > 0:
                v = to[i]
                nd = d + cost[i] + pu - pi[v]
                if nd < dist[v]:
                    dist[v] = nd
                    parent[v] = i
                    changed = True
                    push(heap, (nd, v))
    net.dist = dist
    net.parent = parent
    return changed


def _block_b(net, cap):
    """Recompute the window labels from the slot and flow distances."""
    S = net.S
    J = net.J
    W0 = net.W0
    Z0 = net.Z0
    pi = net.pi
    dist = net.dist
    parent = net.parent
    wdist = net.wdist
    assigned = net.assigned
    lo = net.lo
    hi = net.hi
    earc = net.earc
    arc_zw = net.arc_zw
    wflow = net.wflow
    wready = net.wready
    wvalue = net.wvalue
    log = net.log
    kbuf = net.kbuf
    changed = False
    if S:
        for s in range(S):
            node = 4 + 3 * s
            d = dist[node]
            kbuf[s] = d + pi[node] if d < BIG else BIG
        levels = _build_rmq(kbuf, S)
        for j in range(J):
            wj = W0 + j
            pw = pi[wj]
            best = BIG
            bestarc = -1
            l = lo[j]
            h = hi[j]
            if l <= h:
                m1, i1, m2, i2 = _rmq_query(levels, log, l, h)
                a = assigned[j]
                if a == i1:
                    if m2 < BIG:
                        v = m2 - pw
                        if v < best:
                            best = v
                            bestarc = earc[i2 * J + j]
                else:
                    if m1 < BIG:
                        v = m1 - pw
                        if v < best:
                            best = v
                            bestarc = earc[i1 * J + j]
            i = arc_zw[j]
            if cap[i] > 0:
                zf = Z0 + wflow[j]
                v = dist[zf] + wready[j] + wvalue[j] * W0_k(net) + pi[zf] - pw
                if v < best:
                    best = v
                    bestarc = i
            if best < wdist[j]:
                wdist[j] = best
                parent[wj] = bestarc
                dist[wj] = best
                changed = True
            else:
                dist[wj] = wdist[j]
    else:
        for j in range(J):
            wj = W0 + j
            i = arc_zw[j]
            best = BIG
            bestarc = -1
            if cap[i] > 0:
                zf = Z0 + wflow[j]
                best = dist[zf] + wready[j] + wvalue[j] * W0_k(net) + pi[zf] - pi[wj]
                bestarc = i
            if best < wdist[j]:
                wdist[j] = best
                parent[wj] = bestarc
                dist[wj] = best
                changed = True
            else:
                dist[wj] = wdist[j]
    return changed


def W0_k(net):
    return net.Wvalue


def _full_dijkstra(net, cap):
    """Exact Dijkstra over every residual arc (fallback / verification)."""
    g = net.g
    to = g.to
    cost = g.cost
    adj = g.adj
    wadj = net.wadj
    n = net.n
    pi = net.pi
    W0 = net.W0
    WJ1 = W0 + net.J
    dist = [BIG] * n
    parent = [-1] * n
    heap = []
    ss = net.SS
    dist[ss] = 0
    heappush(heap, (0, ss))
    wdist = net.wdist
    for j in range(net.J):
        d = wdist[j]
        u = W0 + j
        dist[u] = d
        if d < BIG:
            heappush(heap, (d, u))
    while heap:
        d, u = heappop(heap)
        if d > dist[u]:
            continue
        pu = pi[u]
        arcs = wadj[u - W0] if W0 <= u < WJ1 else adj[u]
        for i in arcs:
            if cap[i] > 0:
                v = to[i]
                nd = d + cost[i] + pu - pi[v]
                if nd < dist[v]:
                    dist[v] = nd
                    parent[v] = i
                    heappush(heap, (nd, v))
    for j in range(net.J):
        net.wdist[j] = dist[W0 + j]
    net.dist = dist
    net.parent = parent


def _dijkstra(net, cap):
    """Shortest residual distances; exact by construction when it returns."""
    changed = _block_a(net, cap)
    rounds = 0
    while changed and rounds < MAX_BLOCK_ITER:
        rounds += 1
        improved = _block_b(net, cap)
        if not improved:
            return True
        changed = _block_a(net, cap)
    if changed or rounds >= MAX_BLOCK_ITER:
        _full_dijkstra(net, cap)
    return True


def _augment(net, cap, ss, tt):
    parent = net.parent
    g = net.g
    path = []
    v = tt
    while v != ss:
        i = parent[v]
        if i < 0:
            return 0
        path.append(i)
        v = g.to[i ^ 1]
    f = min(cap[i] for i in path)
    for i in path:
        cap[i] -= f
        cap[i ^ 1] += f
    return f, path


def _sync_state(net, path, cap):
    """Refresh window assignment bookkeeping after an augmentation."""
    earc_first = None
    earc = net.earc
    J = net.J
    S = net.S
    assigned = net.assigned
    wadj = net.wadj
    for i in path:
        j = _window_of_arc(net, i)
        if j < 0:
            continue
        s = _slot_of_arc(net, i)
        if s < 0:
            continue
        ai = earc[s * J + j]
        if ai < 0:
            continue
        cur = assigned[j]
        if cap[ai] == 0:
            if cur != s:
                if cur >= 0:
                    wadj[j].pop()
                wadj[j].append(ai + 1)
                assigned[j] = s
        else:
            if cur == s:
                wadj[j].pop()
                assigned[j] = -1


def _window_of_arc(net, i):
    return net.arc_window.get(i, -1)


def _slot_of_arc(net, i):
    return net.arc_slot.get(i, -1)


def min_cost_flow(net, need):
    cap = net.g.cap
    ss = net.SS
    tt = net.TT
    flow = 0
    guard = 0
    limit = need + 8
    while flow < need:
        guard += 1
        if guard > limit + 8:
            return False
        _dijkstra(net, cap)
        dt = net.dist[tt]
        if dt >= BIG:
            return False
        pi = net.pi
        dist = net.dist
        for v in range(net.n):
            d = dist[v]
            pi[v] += d if d < dt else dt
        res, path = _augment(net, cap, ss, tt)
        if res == 0:
            return False
        flow += res
        _sync_state(net, path, cap)
        for j in range(net.J):
            net.wdist[j] = BIG
    return True


def solve_epoch(case):

    model = case['model']

    fgroup = [row[2] for row in flow_rows]
    gparent = [row[0] for row in group_rows]
    gceil = [row[1] for row in group_rows]
    wflow = [row[0] for row in window_rows]

    wexpires = [row[2] for row in window_rows]

"""Certified epoch planning for the FENIX CPU controller.

The published constraint network of PROTOCOL.md is built explicitly.  Optimal
coverage is found by feasibility max-flows over the candidate ratios, the
lexicographic (utility, age) objective by a min-cost circulation with lower
bounds, and the certificates by residual potentials plus a Hoffman cut.

Min-cost circulation with lower bounds is solved as a min-cost flow with only
nonnegative costs: every window arc is pre-saturated, so each window is either
exported at some slot or explicitly dropped, and the export reward lives on the
reverse arc.  Potentials of that network are mapped back onto the published
cost convention at the end.
"""

from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right
from heapq import heappush, heappop
from fractions import Fraction

BIG = 1 << 110


class Graph:
    """Residual arc list; arcs are stored in pairs (forward at even index)."""

    __slots__ = ('n', 'to', 'cap', 'cost', 'adj')

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.to = []
        self.cap = []
        self.cost = []
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def add(self, u, v, c, cost=0, head_adj=True):

        self.to.append(v)
        self.cap.append(c)
        self.cost.append(cost)
        self.to.append(u)
        self.cap.append(0)
        self.cost.append(-cost)
        self.adj[u].append(i)
        if head_adj:
            self.adj[v].append(i + 1)
        return i


def _log_table(limit):
    log = [0] * (limit + 1)
    for i in range(2, limit + 1):
        log[i] = log[i >> 1] + 1
    return log


def _build_rmq(vals, size):
    """Sparse table with the two smallest (value, index) pairs per range."""
    levels = []
    m1 = list(vals)
    i1 = list(range(size))
    m2 = [BIG] * size
    i2 = [-1] * size
    levels.append((m1, i1, m2, i2))
    j = 1
    while (1 << j) <= size:
        half = 1 << (j - 1)
        pm1, pi1, pm2, pi2 = levels[j - 1]
        nsize = size - (1 << j) + 1
        nm1 = [0] * nsize
        ni1 = [0] * nsize
        nm2 = [0] * nsize
        ni2 = [0] * nsize
        for i in range(nsize):
            k = i + half
            a1 = pm1[i]
            a2 = pm2[i]
            b1 = pm1[k]
            b2 = pm2[k]
            if a1 <= b1:
                nm1[i] = a1
                ni1[i] = pi1[i]
                if a2 <= b1:
                    nm2[i] = a2
                    ni2[i] = pi2[i]
                else:
                    nm2[i] = b1
                    ni2[i] = pi1[k]
            else:
                nm1[i] = b1
                ni1[i] = pi1[k]
                if b2 <= a1:
                    nm2[i] = b2
                    ni2[i] = pi2[k]
                else:
                    nm2[i] = a1
                    ni2[i] = pi1[i]
        levels.append((nm1, ni1, nm2, ni2))
        j += 1
    return levels


def _rmq_query(levels, log, l, r):
    k = log[r - l + 1]
    m1a, i1a, m2a, i2a = levels[k]
    x = l
    y = r - (1 << k) + 1
    a1 = m1a[x]
    a2 = m2a[x]
    b1 = m1a[y]
    b2 = m2a[y]
    if a1 <= b1:
        if a2 <= b1:
            return a1, i1a[x], a2, i2a[x]
        return a1, i1a[x], b1, i1a[y]
    if b2 <= a1:
        return b1, i1a[y], b2, i2a[y]
    return b1, i1a[y], a1, i1a[x]


def _dinic_path(g, cap, level, it, s, t, wlo, whi, wadj):
    to = g.to
    adj = g.adj
    path = []
    u = s
    while True:
        if u == t:
            f = min(cap[i] for i in path)
            for i in path:
                cap[i] -= f
                cap[i ^ 1] += f
            return f
        arcs = wadj[u - wlo] if wlo <= u < whi else adj[u]
        target = level[u] + 1
        idx = it[u]
        na = len(arcs)
        found = -1
        while idx < na:
            i = arcs[idx]
            if cap[i] > 0 and level[to[i]] == target:
                found = i
                break
            idx += 1
        it[u] = idx
        if found >= 0:
            path.append(found)
            u = to[found]
        else:
            if not path:
                return 0
            it[u] = na
            i = path.pop()
            u = to[i ^ 1]
            it[u] += 1


def dinic(g, cap, s, t, wlo, whi, wadj):
    to = g.to
    adj = g.adj
    n = g.n
    total = 0
    while True:
        level = [-1] * n
        level[s] = 0
        q = [s]
        qs = 0
        lt = -1
        while qs < len(q):
            u = q[qs]
            qs += 1
            lu = level[u] + 1
            if lt >= 0 and lu > lt:
                continue
            arcs = wadj[u - wlo] if wlo <= u < whi else adj[u]
            for i in arcs:
                if cap[i] > 0:
                    v = to[i]
                    if level[v] < 0:
                        level[v] = lu
                        if v == t:
                            lt = lu
                        q.append(v)
        if lt < 0:
            break
        it = [0] * n
        nwin = whi - wlo
        while True:
            f = _dinic_path(g, cap, level, it, s, t, wlo, whi, wadj)
            if f == 0:
                break
            total += f
            for j in range(nwin):
                it[wlo + j] = 0
    return total

    net.earc_first = earc_first

    arc_SZ = add(SS, 1, 0, 0)
    arc_Sz = [add(SS, Z0 + f, 0, 0) for f in range(F)]
    arc_zT = [add(Z0 + f, TT, 0, 0) for f in range(F)]
    for j in range(J):

    net.arc_Sz = arc_Sz

    net.log = _log_table(S) if S else [0]
    net.pi = [0] * n
    net.dist = [BIG] * n
    net.parent = [-1] * n
    net.kbuf = [BIG] * S

def set_coverage(net, lowers):
    cap = net.g.cap
    F = net.F
    G = net.G
    sum_group = [0] * G
    sum_root = 0
    fgroup = net.fgroup
    for f in range(F):
        lf = lowers[f]
        if lf:
            gp = fgroup[f]
            if gp >= 0:
                sum_group[gp] += lf
            else:
                sum_root += lf
    for f in range(F):
        lf = lowers[f]
        i = net.arc_zhead[f]
        cap[i] = net.fceil[f] - lf
        cap[i + 1] = lf
        jf = net.Jf[f]
        extra = jf - lf
        cap[net.arc_Sz[f]] = extra if extra > 0 else 0
        cap[net.arc_zT[f]] = (-extra) if extra < 0 else 0
    for gi in range(G):
        cap[net.arc_Sh[gi]] = sum_group[gi]
    cap[net.arc_SZ] = sum_root
    need = 0
    Jf = net.Jf
    for f in range(F):
        d = Jf[f] if Jf[f] > lowers[f] else lowers[f]
        need += d
    return need


def _block_a(net, cap):
    g = net.g
    to = g.to
    cost = g.cost
    adjA = net.adjA
    n = net.n
    pi = net.pi
    dist = [BIG] * n
    parent = [-1] * n
    heap = []
    ss = net.SS
    dist[ss] = 0
    heappush(heap, (0, ss))
    changed = False
    W0 = net.W0
    J = net.J
    wdist = net.wdist
    wadj = net.wadj
    for j in range(J):
        d = wdist[j]
        if d >= BIG:
            continue
        u = W0 + j
        pu = pi[u]
        for i in wadj[j]:
            if cap[i] > 0:
                v = to[i]
                nd = d + cost[i] + pu - pi[v]
                if nd < dist[v]:
                    dist[v] = nd
                    parent[v] = i
                    changed = True
                    heappush(heap, (nd, v))
    while heap:
        d, u = heappop(heap)
        if d > dist[u]:
            continue
        pu = pi[u]
        for i in adjA[u]:
            if cap[i] > 0:
                v = to[i]
                nd = d + cost[i] + pu - pi[v]
                if nd < dist[v]:
                    dist[v] = nd
                    parent[v] = i
                    changed = True
                    heappush(heap, (nd, v))
    net.dist = dist
    net.parent = parent
    return changed


def _block_b(net, cap):
    S = net.S
    J = net.J
    W0 = net.W0
    Z0 = net.Z0
    pi = net.pi
    dist = net.dist
    parent = net.parent
    wdist = net.wdist
    assigned = net.assigned
    lo = net.lo
    hi = net.hi
    earc = net.earc
    arc_zw = net.arc_zw
    wflow = net.wflow
    wready = net.wready
    wvalue = net.wvalue
    log = net.log
    kbuf = net.kbuf
    changed = False
    for s in range(S):
        node = 4 + 3 * s
        d = dist[node]
        kbuf[s] = d + pi[node] if d < BIG else BIG
    levels = _build_rmq(kbuf, S)
    for j in range(J):
        wj = W0 + j
        pw = pi[wj]
        best = BIG
        bestarc = -1
        l = lo[j]
        h = hi[j]
        if l <= h:
            m1, i1, m2, i2 = _rmq_query(levels, log, l, h)
            a = assigned[j]
            if a == i1:
                if m2 < BIG:
                    v = m2 - pw
                    if v < best:
                        best = v
                        bestarc = earc[i2 * J + j]
            else:
                if m1 < BIG:
                    v = m1 - pw
                    if v < best:
                        best = v
                        bestarc = earc[i1 * J + j]
        i = arc_zw[j]
        if cap[i] > 0:
            zf = Z0 + wflow[j]
            v = dist[zf] + wready[j] + wvalue[j] * net.W + pi[zf] - pw
            if v < best:
                best = v
                bestarc = i
        if best < wdist[j]:
            wdist[j] = best
            parent[wj] = bestarc
            dist[wj] = best
            changed = True
        else:
            dist[wj] = wdist[j]
    return changed


def _full_dijkstra(net, cap):
    g = net.g
    to = g.to
    cost = g.cost
    adj = g.adj
    wadj = net.wadj
    n = net.n
    pi = net.pi
    W0 = net.W0
    WJ1 = W0 + net.J
    dist = [BIG] * n
    parent = [-1] * n
    heap = []
    ss = net.SS
    dist[ss] = 0
    heappush(heap, (0, ss))
    wdist = net.wdist
    for j in range(net.J):
        d = wdist[j]
        u = W0 + j
        dist[u] = d
        if d < BIG:
            heappush(heap, (d, u))
    while heap:
        d, u = heappop(heap)
        if d > dist[u]:
            continue
        pu = pi[u]
        arcs = wadj[u - W0] if W0 <= u < WJ1 else adj[u]
        for i in arcs:
            if cap[i] > 0:
                v = to[i]
                nd = d + cost[i] + pu - pi[v]
                if nd < dist[v]:
                    dist[v] = nd
                    parent[v] = i
                    heappush(heap, (nd, v))
    for j in range(net.J):
        net.wdist[j] = dist[W0 + j]
    net.dist = dist
    net.parent = parent


def _dijkstra(net, cap):
    changed = _block_a(net, cap)
    rounds = 0
    while changed and rounds < 2000:
        rounds += 1
        if not _block_b(net, cap):
            return
        changed = _block_a(net, cap)
    if changed:
        _full_dijkstra(net, cap)


def _augment(net, cap, ss, tt):
    parent = net.parent
    to = net.g.to
    path = []
    v = tt
    while v != ss:
        i = parent[v]
        if i < 0:
            return 0, None
        path.append(i)
        v = to[i ^ 1]
    f = min(cap[i] for i in path)
    for i in path:
        cap[i] -= f
        cap[i ^ 1] += f
    return f, path


def _sync_state(net, path, cap):
    first = net.earc_first
    last = first + 2 * len(net.epair)
    epair = net.epair
    assigned = net.assigned
    wadj = net.wadj
    J = net.J
    earc = net.earc
    if not path:
        return
    for i in path:
        if first <= i < last:
            off = i - first
            s, j = epair[off >> 1]
            y = cap[i | 1]
            cur = assigned[j]
            if y:
                if cur != s:
                    if cur >= 0:
                        wadj[j].pop()
                    wadj[j].append(earc[s * J + j] + 1)
                    assigned[j] = s
            else:
                if cur == s:
                    wadj[j].pop()
                    assigned[j] = -1


def min_cost_flow(net, need):
    cap = net.g.cap
    ss = net.SS
    tt = net.TT
    flow = 0
    while flow < need:
        _dijkstra(net, cap)
        dt = net.dist[tt]
        if dt >= BIG:
            return False
        pi = net.pi
        dist = net.dist
        for v in range(net.n):
            d = dist[v]
            pi[v] += d if d < dt else dt
        res, path = _augment(net, cap, ss, tt)
        if res == 0:
            return False
        flow += res
        _sync_state(net, path, cap)
        wdist = net.wdist
        for j in range(net.J):
            wdist[j] = BIG
    return True


def _ceil_mul(r, t):
    num = r.numerator * t
    den = r.denominator
    return -((-num) // den)


def solve_epoch(case):
    from probability import window_thresholds

        else:

    caps = [row[1] for row in slots]
    refills = [row[2] for row in slots]

        'thresholds': thresholds,
        'assignment': assignment,
        'utility': utility,
        'age': age,
        'flow': flow_out,

def _compute_cut(net, oarc, rnext, ftgt, F, G):
    lowers = [_ceil_mul(rnext, ftgt[f]) for f in range(F)]
    K = net.KK
    g1 = Graph(K + 2)

    tt = K + 1

    sum_group = [0] * G

        lf = lowers[f]
        g1.add(net.Z0 + f, tt, lf, 0)
        gp = net.fgroup[f]
        if gp >= 0:
            sum_group[gp] += lf
        else:
            sum_root += lf
    for gi in range(G):
        if sum_group[gi]:
            g1.add(ss, net.H0 + gi, sum_group[gi], 0)
    if sum_root:
        g1.add(ss, 1, sum_root, 0)
    cap = g1.cap
    total = sum(lowers)
    dinic(g1, cap, ss, tt, -1, -1, None)
    if total == 0:
        return None
    # nodes reachable from the super source in the residual graph
    to = g1.to
    adj = g1.adj
    seen = [False] * (K + 2)
    seen[ss] = True
    q = [ss]
    qs = 0
    while qs < len(q):
        u = q[qs]
        qs += 1
        for i in adj[u]:
            if cap[i] > 0:
                v = to[i]
                if not seen[v]:

"""Parametric random case generator."""
import random

def gen_case(rng, J, S, F, G, tight=1.0, span=None):
    model = rng.choice(['cnn', 'rnn'])
    class_values = [rng.randint(1, 1000) for _ in range(7)]
    stats = [rng.randint(1, 10 ** 9) for _ in range(3)]
    B = rng.randint(1, max(1, int(4 * tight)) if tight else 1)
    I = rng.randint(0, B)
    t = 0
    slots = []
    step = span if span else max(1, 10 ** 6 // max(1, S))
    for s in range(S):
        t += rng.randint(1, step)
        slots.append([t, rng.randint(0, max(1, int(J / S * 1.5) + 1)),
                      0 if s == 0 else rng.randint(0, 3)])
    groups = []
    for g in range(G):
        parent = -1 if rng.random() < 0.4 else rng.randint(0, g - 1)
        groups.append([parent, rng.randint(0, max(1, J))])
    flows = []
    for f in range(F):
        tgt = rng.randint(1, max(1, J // F + 1))
        gp = -1 if not G or rng.random() < 0.3 else rng.randint(0, G - 1)
        flows.append([tgt, rng.randint(tgt, tgt + 4), gp, rng.randint(0, 6)])
    windows = []
    for j in range(J):
        f = rng.randrange(F)
        ready = rng.randint(0, slots[-1][0])
        expires = min(slots[-1][0], ready + rng.randint(0, int(span * 2) if span else slots[-1][0]))
        expires = max(expires, ready)
        feats = [[rng.randint(0, 1500), rng.randint(0, 2560)] for _ in range(9)]
        windows.append([f, ready, expires, rng.randint(1, 65535),
                        rng.randint(1, 320), rng.randint(0, 65535),
                        rng.randint(1, 1000), feats])
    return {'model': model, 'class_values': class_values, 'stats': stats,
            'bucket': [B, I], 'slots': slots, 'flows': flows,
            'groups': groups, 'windows': windows}

import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
import planner, verify
from gen2 import gen_case
from probability import window_thresholds
import numpy as np

def run(seedstart, count, sizes):
    bad = 0; worst = 0.0
    for i in range(count):
        seed = seedstart + i
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        J, S, F, G, span = sizes[i % len(sizes)]
        case = gen_case(rng, J, S, F, G, span=span)
        n = len(case['windows'])
        t0 = time.time()
        res = planner.solve_epoch(case)
        el = time.time() - t0
        worst = max(worst, el)
        J2 = len(case['windows'])
        feats = np.array([w[7] for w in case['windows']], dtype=np.int64).reshape(J2,9,2)
        preds = __import__('testcnnonnx' if case['model']=='cnn' else 'testrnnonnx').evaluate_model_single_pass(feats, np.zeros(J2,dtype=np.int64))
        thresholds = window_thresholds(case['stats'], case['windows'])
        values = [case['windows'][j][6] * case['class_values'][preds[j]] for j in range(J2)]
        errs = verify.verify(case, res, thresholds, values)
        if preds != res['predictions']:
            errs.append('preds mismatch')
        if errs:
            print('seed', seed, 'ERRORS', errs[:5]); bad += 1
        else:
            print('seed %d J=%d S=%d ratio=%s served=%d %.2fs' % (seed, n, S, res['ratio'],

    print('done', count, 'bad', bad, 'worst %.2f' % worst)
    return bad

def build(rng, J, S, F, G, cap, tok, wide=True):
    c = gen_case(rng, J, S, F, G, span=10 ** 9)
    for s in c['slots']:

            s[2] = rng.randint(0, 8)

        for w in c['windows']:
            w[1] = 0
            w[2] = last
    return c

def main():
    J = int(sys.argv[1]); S = int(sys.argv[2]); F = int(sys.argv[3]); G = int(sys.argv[4])
    cap = int(sys.argv[5]); tok = int(sys.argv[6]); ncases = int(sys.argv[7])

            len(res['flow']), res['utility'], res['age']))
    return 0

"""Certified epoch planning for the FENIX CPU controller.

The published constraint network of PROTOCOL.md is built explicitly.  Optimal
coverage is found by feasibility max-flows over the candidate ratios, the
lexicographic (utility, age) objective by a min-cost circulation with lower
bounds, and the certificates by residual potentials plus a Hoffman cut.

Min-cost circulation with lower bounds is solved as a min-cost flow with only
nonnegative costs: every window arc is pre-saturated, so each window is either
exported at some slot or explicitly dropped, and the export reward lives on the
reverse arc.  Potentials of that network are mapped back onto the published
cost convention at the end.
"""

from bisect import bisect_left, bisect_right
from heapq import heappush, heappop
from fractions import Fraction

BIG = 1 << 110


class Graph:
    """Residual arc list; arcs are stored in pairs (forward at even index)."""

    __slots__ = ('n', 'to', 'cap', 'cost', 'adj')

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.to = []
        self.cap = []
        self.cost = []
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def add(self, u, v, c, cost=0, head_adj=True):
        i = len(self.to)
        self.to.append(v)
        self.cap.append(c)
        self.cost.append(cost)
        self.to.append(u)
        self.cap.append(0)
        self.cost.append(-cost)
        self.adj[u].append(i)
        if head_adj:
            self.adj[v].append(i + 1)
        return i


def _dinic_path(g, cap, level, it, s, t, wlo, whi, wadj, last):
    to = g.to
    adj = g.adj
    path = []
    u = s
    while True:
        if u == t:
            f = min(cap[i] for i in path)
            for i in path:
                cap[i] -= f
                cap[i ^ 1] += f
            last.append(path)
            return f
        arcs = wadj[u - wlo] if wlo <= u < whi else adj[u]
        target = level[u] + 1
        idx = it[u]
        na = len(arcs)
        found = -1
        while idx < na:
            i = arcs[idx]
            if cap[i] > 0 and level[to[i]] == target:
                found = i
                break
            idx += 1
        it[u] = idx
        if found >= 0:
            path.append(found)
            u = to[found]
        else:
            if not path:
                return 0
            it[u] = na
            i = path.pop()
            u = to[i ^ 1]
            it[u] += 1


def dinic(g, cap, s, t, wlo, whi, wadj, sync=None):
    to = g.to
    adj = g.adj
    n = g.n
    total = 0
    last = []
    while True:

def _augment(net, cap, path):
    f = min(cap[i] for i in path)
    for i in path:
        cap[i] -= f
        cap[i ^ 1] += f
    return f


def _sync_state(net, path, cap):
    first = net.earc_first
    last = first + 2 * len(net.epair)
    epair = net.epair
    assigned = net.assigned
    wadj = net.wadj
    J = net.J
    earc = net.earc
    if not path:
        return
    for i in path:
        if first <= i < last:
            off = i - first
            s, j = epair[off >> 1]
            y = cap[i | 1]
            cur = assigned[j]
            if y:
                if cur != s:
                    if cur >= 0:
                        wadj[j].pop()
                    wadj[j].append(earc[s * J + j] + 1)
                    assigned[j] = s
            else:
                if cur == s:
                    wadj[j].pop()
                    assigned[j] = -1


def min_cost_flow(net, need):
    cap = net.g.cap
    ss = net.SS
    tt = net.TT
    flow = 0
    while flow < need:
        _dijkstra(net, cap)
        dt = net.dist[tt]
        if dt >= BIG:
            return False
        path = _path_from_parents(net, cap)
        if path is None:
            _full_dijkstra(net, cap)
            dt = net.dist[tt]
            if dt >= BIG:
                return False
            path = _path_from_parents(net, cap)
            if path is None:
                return False
        pi = net.pi
        dist = net.dist
        for v in range(net.n):
            d = dist[v]
            pi[v] += d if d < dt else dt
        res = _augment(net, cap, path)
        flow += res
        _sync_state(net, path, cap)
    return True


def _ceil_mul(r, t):
    num = r.numerator * t
    den = r.denominator
    return -((-num) // den)


def solve_epoch(case):
    from probability import window_thresholds

    model = case['model']
    class_values = case['class_values']
    stats = case['stats']
    B, I = case['bucket']
    slots = case['slots']
    flow_rows = case['flows']
    group_rows = case['groups']
    window_rows = case['windows']
    S = len(slots)
    F = len(flow_rows)
    G = len(group_rows)
    J = len(window_rows)

    if J:
        import numpy as np
        feats = np.array([w[7] for w in window_rows],
                         dtype=np.int64).reshape(J, 9, 2)
        labels = np.zeros(J, dtype=np.int64)
        if model == 'cnn':
            import testcnnonnx as evaluator
        else:
            import testrnnonnx as evaluator
        preds = evaluator.evaluate_model_single_pass(feats, labels)
    else:
        preds = []

    thresholds = window_thresholds(stats, window_rows)

    times = [row[0] for row in slots]
    caps = [row[1] for row in slots]
    refills = [row[2] for row in slots]
    ftgt = [row[0] for row in flow_rows]
    fceil = [row[1] for row in flow_rows]
    fgroup = [row[2] for row in flow_rows]
    gparent = [row[0] for row in group_rows]
    gceil = [row[1] for row in group_rows]
    wflow = [row[0] for row in window_rows]
    wready = [row[1] for row in window_rows]
    wexpires = [row[2] for row in window_rows]
    wdraw = [row[5] for row in window_rows]
    wprio = [row[6] for row in window_rows]

    W = 1 + J * times[-1]
    value = [wprio[j] * class_values[preds[j]] for j in range(J)]
    passes = [wdraw[j] < thresholds[j] for j in range(J)]
    lo = [bisect_left(times, wready[j]) for j in range(J)]
    hi = [bisect_right(times, wexpires[j]) - 1 for j in range(J)]

    slot_windows = [[] for _ in range(S)]
    for j in range(J):
        if not passes[j]:
            continue
        l = lo[j]
        h = hi[j]
        if l > h:
            continue
        for s in range(l, h + 1):
            slot_windows[s].append(j)

    net = build_net(times, caps, refills, B, I, F, fceil, fgroup, G, gparent,
                    gceil, J, wflow, wready, slot_windows, value, W)
    net.lo = lo
    net.hi = hi
    net.ftgt = ftgt
